prompt_text: What are the best vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County California and how do I pick one?
ai_overview_text:
The best vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County range from beachfront escapes in Pajaro Dunes to redwood cabins in Felton, with nightly rates typically starting around $110 to over $900 depending on the property type and location. HomeToGo | Vacation Rentals +2
Properties: Harbor Hideaway or Harbor House A.
Vibe: Steps from the harbor and sandy shores.
Features: 2 bedrooms, sleeping 4 to 6 guests; average rates around $200–$400/night; close to local seafood spots and walking paths. Kendall & Potter +1
Properties: Brand New Luxury Capitola Village Home.
Vibe: Colorful seaside village atmosphere.
Features: Modern design, walkable to the beach and boutique shops, rated 9.4/10 by guests. Vrbo +2
Properties: Family-oriented vacation homes near Seacliff State Beach.
Vibe: Quieter coastal stretch with expansive sandy beaches.
Features: Multi-bedroom layouts with yards, hot tubs, and ocean views, averaging $400–$800/night. Kendall & Potter +3
Properties: Fern River Resort or local redwoods cabins/treehouses.
Vibe: Secluded forest canopy and river streams.
Features: Cozy rustic cabins near Henry Cowell Redwoods, highly rated (9.2/10) for quiet nature retreats. Expedia +2
Choose Your Setting (Coast vs. Redwoods): Decide if you want an oceanfront view in Santa Cruz/Capitola or a peaceful mountain escape among the redwoods. Instagram·amy ✿ travel photographer +1
Check Local Regulations: Keep in mind that short-term rental rules in the county are strict; developments like Pajaro Dunes and Seascape Resort are primary hubs explicitly zoned for resort and short-term stays. HolidayHomes.com +1
Filter for Specific Amenities: Prioritize features based on your group—look for pet-friendly tags (about 23–26% of local inventory), fenced yards for kids, hot tubs, or EV charging outlets if you are driving an electric vehicle. KAYAK +2
Time Your Visit: Rates peak heavily from June through August and major holidays, while off-peak winter months (December to February) offer lower averages and better availability. Vrbo +1
